text:
Ethan Liu: quick follow-up from today's all-hands - can we get sharper dates on streaming API, Console rollout controls (canaries/weights/fallback), and Optimize recommendation rollout? teams are planning sprints.

Maya Singh: short answer: streaming public beta target = Sept 2026 (mid-Q3), GA = Nov 2026. Console rollout controls beta = Oct 2026, GA = Feb 2027. Optimize (recommendations only) pilot = Dec 2026. these are target windows and depend on a couple infra blockers.

Carlton Reyes: infra/eng note: hitting Sept beta requires a kernel/ops freeze by 2026-06-15 and a 5-week dogfood window. there's an ongoing perf regression with KV eviction that could push things ~3 wks if not fixed.

Ethan Liu: is the KV eviction regression linked to model pinning or just caching subsystem?

Carlton Reyes: mostly caching subsystem + edge-case in concurrent evictions. model pinning uncovered it during load test. we're triaging but timeline risk exists.

Priya Shah: from product standpoint: Console needs to show per-route ephemeral cost estimate and an easy fallback toggle. will rollout presets be available?

Maya Singh: yes presets (5%, 20%, 50%, 100%) and a custom slider. rollout policy options: latency-first, cost-first, reliability-first. default will be latency-first with an automatic fallback trigger at p95 latency +30%.

Rina Gupta: docs/devex: we'll need sample eval harness + prompt sets for Optimize so owners can validate quality vs quantization/batching tradeoffs. can product attach that to the roadmap ticket?

Maya Singh: action: attach eval harness + canonical prompts by 2026-06-12. eng to confirm kernel freeze and regression status by 2026-06-02. docs draft for beta comms by 2026-07-10.

Carlton Reyes: SDK note: streaming helpers (python/js) will be in beta SDKs. sample snippet we'll include in the beta docs:

```js
const stream = client.stream.create({ model: 'redwood-variant', stream: true })
stream.on('token', t => process.stdout.write(t))
stream.on('end', () => console.log('done'))
```

Ethan Liu: will streaming support function/tool call streaming as well?

Maya Singh: yes function call streaming in beta. tool-call streaming is in scope for initial beta.

Priya Shah: Dedicated timeline? will dedicated customers get the beta at same time?

Carlton Reyes: Dedicated will trail hosted by ~6 weeks for streaming due to capacity validation and infra mapping. private/on-prem by request after GA.

Rina Gupta: ops/comms: expect a short stability window during beta where non-prod traffic may be limited. release-bot: canary smoke test scheduled 2026-06-08 03:00 UTC.

release-bot: [automated] scheduled canary smoke test for streaming infra on 2026-06-08 03:00 UTC. expect ~10m validation window.

Ethan Liu: recap action items from thread:
- Product (Maya): attach sample eval harness + prompts to roadmap ticket by 2026-06-12
- Eng (Carlton): confirm kernel freeze date and update on KV eviction regression by 2026-06-02
- Docs/DevEx (Rina): draft beta comms and SDK examples by 2026-07-10
- Infra: finalize Dedicated validation plan and canary windows by 2026-06-07

Maya Singh: I'll spin up the follow-up doc + milestone board and ping owners. thanks all 680
